XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Instrument panel inactive, protective fuse broken
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ACCESSORIES | PANEL | INSTRUMENTS | INACTIVE | IGNITION | DISPLAY | ROUND | P0501 | B1010

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: accessories

  • Device: tailgate opening

  • Fault: instrument panel not working, opening the driver's door turns on the round display in the centre of the panel, protection fuse broken

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0501, B1010

  • Cause: tailgate wiring damaged

• Action: restore the tailgate wiring, replace fuse F11 (5 amp capacity) in the passenger compartment fuse box

  • Procedure: move the rubber sheath protecting the tailgate wiring and restore worn or broken wires

  • Note: repair time approximately 30 minutes
